stories.title: Weather Impact: Breezy & cool Tuesday, turning wet & windy by Wednesday evening
stories.summary: Heavy rain & gusty winds may cause headaches for your Turkey Day plans.

stories.title: Police say relative of student charged after bringing gun on Reedy Fork Elementary campus
stories.summary: School will resume as usual on Tuesday, according to Guilford County Schools.

stories.title: Greensboro police charge three in deadly September shooting outside Club O
stories.summary: Two more people have been charged in connection with the deadly Club O shooting on West Market Street that killed Marvin Allen Watlington and injured five others.

stories.title: Family asks for release of High Point mom accused of burning son with household iron
stories.summary: During Monday's hearing, McDuffie's bond was set at $250,000. Her next court appearance is scheduled for Jan. 29.

stories.title: Person hospitalized after shooting on Big Tree Way in Greensboro, police say
stories.summary: Police have not said what led to the shooting or whether anyone is in custody.

stories.title: USPS Operation Santa: Allows kids to write letters, their wish list can be adopted & the Post Office delivers the gifts
stories.summary: The program is 100 years old, and through the program's evolution, Santa gets a few helpers. How you can write a letter or adopt a letter.

stories.title: Forsyth County deputies searching for missing 14-year-old girl
stories.summary: Forsyth County deputies are asking for help locating a missing 14-year-old last seen near Bridle Path in Winston-Salem.

stories.title: Where is your turkey right now? If it's in your freezer, act now!
stories.summary: It takes days for turkeys to thaw from being in the freezer. How to do a quicker cold-water thaw.

stories.title: Bond denied for High Point chase suspect during first court appearance
stories.summary: Police say the pursuit involved six crashes and reports of shots fired at officers. No officers were injured.

stories.title: Greensboro Science Center euthanizes 3 aging animals, including Tai the red panda
stories.summary: Tai, Raspberry the giant Pacific octopus and Silver Surfer the spotted eagle ray were all at or past the typical life expectancy for their species.

stories.title: Driver charged after hit-and-run, rollover crash on U.S. 52 in Winston-Salem
stories.summary: Lamont Williams Jr., 27, faces 11 charges, including hit-and-run, driving while license revoked and aggressive driving, according to police.

stories.title: Man sentenced after his 8-year-old son accidentally shot, killed himself in Winston-Salem
stories.summary: A man has been sentenced to 1-2 years in prison after his 8-year-old son shot himself with his gun at their Winston-Salem home in 2025.
